Yes — Mira has a confirmed **egg allergy** (mild hives), confirmed by Riverdale Pediatrics. That's the one to flag clearly to any new caregiver.

A few things worth passing along:

- **No egg** in any form — that includes baked goods, pasta, and sauces where it's easy to miss.
- Let them know the reaction is mild hives, so they know what to watch for.
- Make sure they have a way to reach you quickly, and know whether you keep any medication on hand (your pediatric office can advise on that if you haven't already).

No other allergies are on record for Mira. If anything else has come up recently, it's worth adding it so caregivers always have the full picture.
